prompt: Company profile: Regional trucking terminal outside Billings, Montana; 40 employees. Situation: The company is installing a 2,000-gallon aboveground diesel tank for fleet fueling. Existing oil storage: a 500-gallon used-oil tank, a 275-gallon heating-oil tote, and four 55-gallon drums of lube oil. A drainage ditch at the property line connects to a creek. Ask: Identify the compliance obligations this situation creates or affects for the compliance-obligations register. For each obligation: state the requirement, its source, its applicability to this company, the ISO clause it maps to (ISO 14001 6.1.3 / ISO 45001 6.1.3), and how and when compliance should be evaluated (9.1.2).
response:
# Compliance Obligations Register: Regional Trucking Terminal – Billings, Montana

**Facility Profile:** 40-employee trucking terminal; installing 2,000-gal diesel AST; existing oil storage totals 995 gallons; drainage ditch connects to creek.

---

## **1. Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasure (SPCC) Plan**

| Element | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Requirement** | Develop, certify, and implement an SPCC Plan; provide secondary containment (40 CFR 112.7); conduct inspections (112.8); train personnel (112.7(f)) |
| **Source** | EPA 40 CFR 112 (Oil Pollution Prevention) |
| **Applicability** | **Yes** – Total aboveground storage capacity (2,995 gal) exceeds 1,320-gallon threshold and facility has potential to discharge to navigable waters via ditch/creek |
| **ISO Clause** | ISO 14001:2015 6.1.3 (Environmental compliance obligations) |
| **Evaluation (9.1.2)** | **How:** Annual plan review; monthly tank inspections; periodic third-party audits. **When:** Upon installation, then annually by Professional Engineer; monthly visual inspections documented; after any spill or equipment modification |

---

## **2. Montana Aboveground Storage Tank (AST) Registration & Standards**

| Element | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Requirement** | Register all ASTs >1,100 gallons with MT DEQ; comply with design, installation, and leak detection standards (ARM 17.56.101–17.56.401) |
| **Source** | Montana Code Annotated § 75-11-201; Administrative Rules of Montana (ARM) 17.56.101 et seq. |
| **Applicability** | **Yes** – Diesel tank (2,000 gal) and used-oil tank (500 gal) exceed 1,100-gallon state registration threshold |
| **ISO Clause** | ISO 14001:2015 6.1.3 |
| **Evaluation (9.1.2)** | **How:** Verify DEQ registration certificate; inspect tanks per ARM 17.56.301; review installation records. **When:** Prior to commissioning; annually for registration renewal; quarterly for leak detection system checks |

---

## **3. Montana Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (MPDES) Stormwater Permit**

| Element | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Requirement** | Obtain industrial stormwater permit; develop Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plan (SWPPP); implement best management practices (BMPs) |
| **Source** | Montana Water Quality Act (MCA 75-5-401); 40 CFR 122.26; Montana Pollutant Discharge Elimination System General Permit MTRI00000 |
| **Applicability** | **Yes** – Fueling operations are industrial activity (Sector N: Motor Freight Transportation); direct connection to waterway via ditch triggers permit requirement |
| **ISO Clause** | ISO 14001:2015 6.1.3 |
| **Evaluation (9.1.2)** | **How:** Quarterly stormwater sampling; annual SWPPP review; monthly BMP inspections. **When:** Within 90 days of facility modification; quarterly discharge monitoring reports; after storm events >0.5 inches |

---

## **4. OSHA Flammable & Combustible Liquids Standard**

| Element | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Requirement** | Install tanks per NFPA 30; maintain 40-foot separation from property line (1910.106(b)(2)(ii)); provide fire protection; post signage |
| **Source** | 29 CFR 1910.106; NFPA 30 (Flammable and Combustible Liquids Code) |
| **Applicability** | **Yes** – Diesel is Class II combustible liquid; AST installation triggers requirements |
| **ISO Clause** | ISO 45001:2018 6.1.3 (OH&S legal requirements) |
| **Evaluation (9.1.2)** | **How:** Pre-installation design review; fire marshal inspection; weekly safety checks. **When:** Before tank operation; annually for fire code compliance; after any structural modifications |

---

## **5. Used Oil Management Standards**

| Element | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Requirement** | Label tanks "Used Oil"; maintain storage records; ensure proper disposal; comply with transporter requirements (if self-transport) |
| **Source** | 40 CFR 279 (Standards for Used Oil Management); Montana Used Oil Collection and Recycling Act (MCA 75-10-201) |
| **Applicability** | **Yes** – 500-gallon used-oil tank is regulated storage; facility generates used oil from fleet maintenance |
| **ISO Clause** | ISO 14001:2015 6.1.3 |
| **Evaluation (9.1.2)** | **How:** Review disposal manifests; inspect tank labeling; audit vendor qualifications. **When:** Quarterly for manifest tracking; annually for vendor re-qualification; monthly for tank integrity checks |

---

## **6. Emergency Planning & Spill Reporting**

| Element | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Requirement** | Report spills >25 gallons or any amount reaching water to MT DEQ within 24 hours; maintain emergency contacts; conduct drills |
| **Source** | Montana Water Quality Act (MCA 75-5-1101); 40 CFR 110 (Discharge Reporting); 29 CFR 1910.38 (Emergency Action Plan) |
| **Applicability** | **Yes** – All oil storage containers; immediate reporting required due to creek proximity |
| **ISO Clause** | ISO 14001:2015 6.1.3 & ISO 45001:2018 6.1.3 |
| **Evaluation (9.1.2)** | **How:** Annual spill drill documentation; review of spill log; verify emergency equipment (spill kits, absorbents). **When:** Within 24 hours of any spill event; annually for emergency response plan review; quarterly for drill exercises |

---

## **7. Secondary Containment Integrity Testing**

| Element | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Requirement** | Secondary containment must hold 110% of largest tank; inspect for cracks, corrosion, and drainage; remove accumulated rainwater |
| **Source** | 40 CFR 112.8(c)(2); ARM 17.56.301(4); IFC 5704.2.11 |
| **Applicability** | **Yes** – Required for diesel AST and used-oil tank; must be impermeable and chemically compatible |
| **ISO Clause** | ISO 14001:2015 6.1.3 |
| **Evaluation (9.1.2)** | **How:** Visual inspection after precipitation; annual integrity testing (hydrostatic or dye test); measurement of containment capacity. **When:** Monthly minimum; within 24 hours of storms; annually before freeze-thaw season |

---

## **8. Hazard Communication (HazCom) & Training**

| Element | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Requirement** | Maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS) for diesel and oils; train employees on chemical hazards; label containers per GHS |
| **Source** | 29 CFR 1910.1200; Montana Safety Culture Act (MCA 39-71-1501) |
| **Applicability** | **Yes** – All employees handling fuel or working in fueling area must be trained |
| **ISO Clause** | ISO 45001:2018 6.1.3 |
| **Evaluation (9.1.2)** | **How:** Review training records; interview employees; inspect SDS accessibility. **When:** Annually for refresher training; within 30 days of new hire; after process changes; during internal audits (semi-annually) |

---

## **9. Tank Inspection & Maintenance Program**

| Element | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Requirement** | Monthly external inspections; annual external corrosion assessment; periodic internal inspections per API 653; maintain inspection logs |
| **Source** | 40 CFR 112.8(c)(6); API 653 (Tank Inspection, Repair, Alteration, and Reconstruction); ARM 17.56.301 |
| **Applicability** | **Yes** – 2,000-gallon diesel AST requires formal inspection program |
| **ISO Clause** | ISO 14001:2015 6.1.3 & ISO 45001:2018 6.1.3 |
| **Evaluation (9.1.2)** | **How:** Review inspection logs; verify inspector qualifications; compare findings to acceptance criteria. **When:** Monthly for operator inspections; annually for certified inspector assessment; every 5 years for internal inspection |

---

## **10. Fire Code & Local Permitting**

| Element | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Requirement** | Obtain building and fire permits; comply with International Fire Code (IFC) as adopted by Yellowstone County; maintain fire extinguishers (20-B:C rating within 30 feet) |
| **Source** | Yellowstone County Fire Code (adopts IFC 2021); Montana Fire Prevention Code; local zoning ordinances |
| **Applicability** | **Yes** – New AST installation requires permit and fire marshal approval |
| **ISO Clause** | ISO 45001:2018 6.1.3 |
| **Evaluation (9.1.2)** | **How:** Verify permit approvals; inspect fire extinguisher tags; review fire marshal inspection reports. **When:** Pre-operational; annually for fire extinguisher maintenance; after any code updates; during fire marshal inspections (biennial) |

---

## **11. Release Detection & Monitoring**

| Element | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Requirement** | Install tank gauging/alarms; monitor for unauthorized releases; maintain 30-day release detection records |
| **Source** | ARM 17.56.401; 40 CFR 112.8(c)(3); PEI RP200 |
| **Applicability** | **Yes** – Required for all regulated ASTs in Montana |
| **ISO Clause** | ISO 14001:2015 6.1.3 |
| **Evaluation (9.1.2)** | **How:** Test alarm functionality; review release detection logs; verify sensor calibration. **When:** Monthly for alarm tests; annually for sensor calibration; during each fuel delivery |

---

## **12. Contractor Safety Management**

| Element | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Requirement** | Ensure tank installation contractor has OSHA 10/30 training; verify contractor insurance; communicate site hazards |
| **Source** | 29 CFR 1910.12 (Construction OSHA); Montana Contractor Registration Act; ISO 45001:2018 8.1.4 |
| **Applicability** | **Yes** – Installation phase and ongoing maintenance contractors |
| **ISO Clause** | ISO 45001:2018 6.1.3 |
| **Evaluation (9.1.2)** | **How:** Pre-qualification audit; review contractor safety records; site safety orientation sign-in sheets. **When:** Before contractor mobilization; quarterly for active contractors; after any safety incidents |

---

### **Summary Compliance Evaluation Framework (ISO 9.1.2)**

| **Method** | **Frequency** | **Records** |
|------------|---------------|-------------|
| Management System Audit | Annually | Audit report, non-conformances |
| Regulatory Inspection | Per schedule (varies) | Inspection reports, corrective actions |
| Records Review | Quarterly | Training logs, inspection sheets, manifests |
| Internal Compliance Review | Monthly | Checklists, meeting minutes |
| Third-Party Assessment | Every 3 years | SPCC re-certification, tank integrity |

**Note:** All obligations require maintaining documented evidence of compliance for ISO 14001:2015/45001:2018 certification audits. The drainage ditch to creek significantly increases regulatory scrutiny and requires immediate spill response capability (e.g., spill kit rated for 2,200 gallons at fueling area).
